entries.comment: Unauthenticated GET /ping — health probe used by external monitors. PingController.cs:23 marks [AllowAnonymous]; the response body is the literal {"status":"OK"} when ConfigRepository.All() succeeds.
Unauthenticated HEAD /ping — same probe path, body omitted per RFC 9110. PingController.cs binds both [HttpGet] and [HttpHead] to the same handler.

GET /api with a valid X-Api-Key — ApiInfoController.cs:8 returns the constant {current:v5,deprecated:[v3]} body. Auth is enforced by Startup's FallbackPolicy since the controller has no [AllowAnonymous].
GET /api without an API key — ApiKeyAuthenticationHandler.HandleChallengeAsync sets StatusCode=401 with no body or Content-Type. skip_api_key keeps the runner from injecting its default X-Api-Key.
